summary.headline: JG Chemicals posted record Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue of INR315.7 crores (+44.8% YoY) and EBITDA margin of 11.5%, with PAT at INR26.1 crores.
summary.overview: Management reported all-time quarterly highs for revenue, EBITDA and PAT in Q1 FY27, with revenue up 10.3% sequentially. Utilisation is in the early 80s (of achievable capacity) and volume growth was in double digits across categories. Management attributed margin gains to operating leverage, higher-priced and specialised orders, cost-reduction initiatives and a small inventory gain that it declined to quantify. The Dahej (Gujarat) greenfield plant is now guided for commissioning around November 2026 (Q3 FY27), later than the earlier first-half target, and guidance was reset to 50-60% utilisation in FY28 and about 14-15% EBITDA margin.

financial_highlights.change: Management said mid-teens for current quarter in a later answer
Rising every quarter/year per management; prior-period figures not given

segments.name: Zinc oxide / rubber and tire (core)
segments.commentary: Tire and rubber remain the largest pillar; company supplies every Indian major tire maker and 9 of the top 10 global tire companies. Tire approvals take about 5 years.

segments.name: Non-rubber (pharma, ceramics, specialty chemicals, agri, cosmetics, electronics)
segments.commentary: Около 18% of revenue this quarter. Ceramics is being seeded for about a year; approval cycle in ceramics estimated at 1-3 months versus about 5 years in tire.

segments.name: Zinc sulphate
segments.commentary: Less than 5-6% of FY26 sales. Southern India is the core market; Western India expansion planned using by-product raw material from Dahej.

segments.name: Recycled rubber (JG TUR) and new products (LabPure zinc oxide, JG-ZRA)
segments.commentary: JG TUR pilot trials well received; commercial launch hoped within about 12 months, capex and revenue not yet disclosed. LabPure and JG-ZRA introduced this quarter as niche, higher-margin grades.

guidance_outlook: Dahej (Gujarat) greenfield Phase 1 of about 15,000-17,000 tpa zinc oxide: commissioning around November 2026 (Q3 FY27); revenue potential INR300-400 crores; EBITDA margin 11-12%; total greenfield capacity about 40,000 tpa.
Dahej utilisation guidance: 50-60% in FY28 (first full year), about 70-80% in FY29; Phase 2 expansion to start around then.
Consolidated EBITDA margin: management now targets about 14-15% (previously 13-14%), with a 14% reference point stated later; current-year margins expected to stay near current level.
Naidupeta brownfield expansion (about 5,000 tpa debottlenecking) expected to commission in Q3 FY27; Naidupeta capex figure to be provided offline.
Management expects higher sales in Q2 FY27 and similar margin profile to continue into the current quarter.
Export share of sales 10-15% today, about 15% expected in FY28-29.
Target payback 3-4 years and ROCE in mid-20s on new capex, per management.
capex_capacity: Installed capacity at West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh facilities close to 70,000 tpa; combined capacity to exceed 115,000 tpa after Dahej phases are on stream.
Dahej greenfield (Gujarat): about INR100 crores investment, civil work advanced, equipment installation underway; commissioning around November 2026.
Naidupeta brownfield: about 5,000 tpa added, expected Q3 FY27. Capex amount not disclosed; to be shared offline.
Q1 FY27 capex and remaining FY27 capex not disclosed on call; management said it would follow up offline.
Naidupeta solar Phase 1 operational; R&D centre at Naidupeta inaugurated.
Proposed UAE subsidiary (BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO) to source raw materials and handle global distribution; not yet incorporated.
demand_pricing: ATMA data cited: Q1 FY27 vehicle volume growth of up to 26.6% for passenger vehicles, 16.5% two-wheelers, 16.5% commercial vehicles and over 11% three-wheelers.
Tire industry capex of about INR25,000 crores announced; about 25% of Indian tire output exported.
Management expects zinc-linked realisations to stay higher ('new normal') as commodity prices have risen; says company is neutral to zinc price levels.

Raw material: zinc dross supply disrupted by geopolitical conflict, but company maintained uninterrupted supply; management said crisis favoured established suppliers and shifted some customers toward JGC.
Around 90% of new sales expected to be direct to customers rather than through distributors.
Dahej customer mix guided at about 60% tire and 40% other segments.

qa_highlights.question: How much of EBITDA came from inventory gains and how much is reversible?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said margin came from operating leverage, higher-priced and specialised orders, and only a small inventory gain; amount not quantified. Margins of 10-12% are structural, with upside from value-added products.

qa_highlights.question: Will Dahej commission early or late in Q3?
Will realisations sustain?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said higher realisations are the new normal given higher commodity prices, and he sees no near-term reversal.

qa_highlights.question: Why was the FY28 Dahej utilisation guidance lowered from 65-70% to 50-60%, and the margin guidance raised from 13-14% to 14-15%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the cut is conservatism because the plant start moved from H1 to Q3 FY27; it still sees close to 60%. The margin rise reflects new products and higher-realisation product launches.

qa_highlights.question: What are the payback and ROCE targets?
qa_highlights.answer: Payback of 3-4 years targeted, implying about 20-25% annual returns; ROCE expected in the mid-20s.

qa_highlights.question: What is the volume growth outlook and split between zinc oxide and zinc sulphate?
qa_highlights.answer: Mid-teens volume growth in the current quarter. The 15,000-17,000 tpa Dahej Phase 1 is all zinc oxide. Zinc sulphate is less than 5-6% of sales.

qa_highlights.question: Will the new products (LabPure, ZRA) carry higher margins and what is their market size?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said these are niche, higher-margin products for non-tire customers, slow to ramp; no market size or margin figures given.
